name: Coronal Mass Ejection
concept: White-hot star at center throwing ragged polar-noise plasma tongues and occasional torn-off prominences, white core to gold to ember.
visual_verdict: Bright gold core with wispy amber tongues swirling outward over black; reads as a star, though the tongues are faint and the hue is fixed amber by default (spec's slow wheel cycle is off).
perf_smell: hypot + atan2 + 3-octave perlinTurbulence per pixel, plus a per-pixel loop over 4 eruptions
cleanroom_quality: Deliberate fork: keeps the polar-turbulence + noisy-core idea and adds real eruptions and a blackbody ramp; better than a literal port, but defaulting hue cycle to 0 loses the spec's slow color drift.
action_notes: Survivor for the coronal pair: absorb coronal-ejection-2d as Arms (1-12), Twist and a Mirror toggle (same engine, same eruption system). Perf: evaluate turbulence on a small polar canvas (angle x radius, ~64x24) once per frame and sample it per pixel instead of 3 octaves per pixel; default hue cycle to ~20 s.

name: Crawling Spider 2D
concept: A red-orange eight-legged spider with an alternating gait crawls across the panel, re-entering from a random direction each pass.
technique: per-pixel capsule SDF over 16 leg segments
visual_verdict: Clearly a spider: red abdomen, amber-to-yellow-green jointed legs, walks across and leaves; about a fifth of frames are black dead time between passes.
perf_smell: 8 point-to-segment distances + 2 hypot per pixel every frame for a few strokes
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the idea better than the spec (real jointed legs instead of mirrored spokes); only the long off-screen gap is inherited dead air.
action_notes: Same spider engine as dire-spider-2d (identical leg tables and SDF); dire-spider at Glow 0 already IS this pattern, so delete this file and rely on that control. The survivor should be rebuilt in renderBulk (16 drawLine capsules + fillCircle body) with a shorter off-screen gap.

name: Crossfading
concept: Framework demo: rotates three hardcoded sub-patterns (blue-violet reciprocal braid, dashed scrolling rainbow, red KITT pulse) with timed RGB crossfades.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows the cyan-magenta braid with a nice wandering knot, then hard dashed rainbow blocks; the red pulse segment is the weakest; transitions are muddy RGB averages.
perf_smell: two sub-renderers per pixel during fades via function-pointer dispatch (cheap at strip sizes)
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: the whole point (timed rotation with dissolves) is what the device playlist with crossfade already does; at most a scene
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the framework demo; the idea itself is plumbing, not a look.
action_notes: Playlists already crossfade between patterns, so the host framework is redundant library content. If anything is salvaged, lift the reciprocal-band 'braid' (sub-pattern 0) into a standalone strip pattern with OKLCH hues and a moving focus control.

name: Crosshair Pulse 2D
concept: QMK reactive-nexus idea: each hit (event or phantom) fires four pulses racing out along its row and column plus a center flash.
visual_verdict: Mostly black; occasional small four-dot crosses that are dim and short-lived, roughly a quarter of frames show anything at all.
perf_smell: per-pixel loop over 4 events with dist() per event
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Fold into ripples-2d as an Effect mode (Ripple / Nexus cross) sharing its event + phantom-drop plumbing; render in renderBulk with fade() trails and four splat/drawLine heads per hit plus setGlow, so the crosses leave bright streaks instead of faint dots.

name: Crosstown Traffic 2D
concept: Soft rainbow bars like headlights glide along horizontal and vertical lanes at random speeds, hues rotating together.
visual_verdict: Starts black, then fills with crisp crisscrossing colored bars; reads as a busy street grid, a bit flat (bars are nearly hard-edged).
perf_smell: 24 point-to-segment tests per pixel (heaviest in this range at 2.6 ms/1024 px)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec faithfully (map-driven, clean transpose); inherits the empty-panel start and same-direction-only traffic.
action_notes: renderBulk: clear() or fade() for light trails, then one drawLine per car (24 calls/frame) with add blending so crossings glow; let lanes run both directions, start with cars on screen, and replace the three bare 0..1 dials with real units (width px, crossing seconds, hue cycle seconds).

name: cube fire 3D
concept: Volumetric plasma blobs from the product of three phase-drifting axis waves, overdriven so crests bleach white; hue cycles.
visual_verdict: On a 2D slice one giant blob fills the panel and blows out to flat white in several frames, alternating with black; garish and coarse, nothing like fire.
perf_smell: none (cheap waves)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the spec's math, but the spec's own constants (half a cycle across, 10x overdrive) make a white-flood blob on 2D panels; the idea is thin.
action_notes: Keep as a 3D-volume plasma only if rewritten: default 2-3 cells across, gain ~3 so cores bleach without flooding, blackbody OKLCH ramp instead of full-wheel hsv; otherwise delete and let a proper 3D plasma (simplex3) cover cube installations.

name: Curl Flow 2D
concept: Two dozen specks advected through a sliding curl-noise field leave decaying cyan-violet trails.
visual_verdict: Busy blue-violet squiggles everywhere, visibly blocky from the 16x16 canvas upscale; reads as worms more than flowing streamlines.
perf_smell: none, but the 16x16 canvas wastes a 64x64 panel
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Make it the library's flagship flow field: renderBulk with fade() trails on the frame itself and splat()/setPixel per speck at native resolution, 100-200 specks, hue from speed or heading in OKLCH, optional setGlow; absorb flow-field-2d as a mode (plain noise heading vs curl).

name: Custom Sequences
concept: Configurable eaves/bulb sequence: up to 12 picked colors in equal runs, chasing either way, with blend, trailing fade, twinkles and periodic blink.
technique: per-pixel run lookup + random phase table
visual_verdict: Hard red/blue blocks that shift one step once; static-looking by default (chase dead-zone default), exactly a holiday-eaves config tool.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful and complete; the bare 0..1 sliders with fifth-power and cubic responses are hard to use.
action_notes: Keep as the single 'color sequence' utility for permanent eave installs and absorb the simple fixed-color-run patterns (static-christmas-lights-4-colors, 2-colors, 3-color-rotation) as its defaults; convert dials to real units (Colors 1-12 step 1, Run Length px, Chase px/s signed, Blink period s) and default to a slow visible chase.

name: Cyclic Cellular Automata 2D
concept: Greenberg-Hastings excitable medium (spiral wave fronts) and a classic cyclic CA (coarsening into spiral demons) on a toroidal grid, re-seeding when dead.
visual_verdict: Blocky 16x16 cells on a flat dull-red field (resting state renders as half-bright red, not dark), noisy green/yellow clumps; no readable spirals at this size and several frames are nearly all red.
perf_smell: hard-coded 16x16 with floor(y*15.99)*16 row arithmetic; interpreted CA loop is fine at 256 cells but cannot scale
cleanroom_quality: Rules are implemented as specified, but the spec's own color map (wave of state, resting at mid brightness) kills the 'mostly-dark field' look the spec promises, and 16x16 is too coarse for spirals to form.
action_notes: Keep the idea (spiral waves are a showcase on 64x64): grid sized from gridWidth/Height up to 48-64 per side, resting state black with an OKLCH ramp on the refractory ladder, output via paintCanvas/fillCanvas in renderBulk, and real-unit controls (steps/s, lifetime s, Mode 0..1 step 1, states count).

name: Cylon
concept: Classic Cylon/Larson scanner: one bright head sweeps end to end leaving a cubed decaying trail in a per-pixel buffer.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows the red head bouncing with a short tail; correct and clean, but the most generic pattern there is.
perf_smell: array(pixelCount) buffer + interpreted decay loop where fade() on the frame would do
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec exactly; the idea is a one-liner the library has four copies of.
action_notes: Collapse cylon, kitt, kitt-w-color-picker (and scanner) into one Scanner pattern (kitt.js as survivor): renderBulk with fade() + fillRange stamping the swept span so no gaps, color picker, real-unit Sweep seconds and Tail length, plus modes for single eye / dual eye / bounce-with-easing.

name: DBZBattleFinal
concept: Endless anime energy battle: warm and cool aura orbs dart, clash in white shockwave rings, fire cyan projectiles and stage a mutual-fire finale.
visual_verdict: Two small orange and violet orbs bobbing at mid-height with occasional thin grey rings and tiny cyan dots; the story is there but everything is small and dim on 32x32.
perf_smell: per-pixel hypot over 8 rings + 2 fighters + 2 projectiles
cleanroom_quality: Behavior sim matches the spec closely; visuals are literal-port tiny discs and the hue sliders are bare 0..1 turns.
action_notes: renderBulk: splat (add mode) auras with a fade() trail behind dashes, fillCircle cores, rings drawn as an outer fillCircle minus an inner one or a few drawLine arcs, plus setGlow; make the finale a real beam struggle (two drawLine beams meeting and pushing) and give hues degree units.

name: Digital Rain 2D
concept: Matrix-style falling code: per-column heads at random speeds with hashed glyph flicker in the green trails.
visual_verdict: Convincing green rain with white-ish heads and flickering trails across all frames; dense and lively, the best of the matrix-rain family here.
perf_smell: none (hard-coded 16 columns via floor(x*15.999))
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Survivor of the matrix-rain family: derive column count from gridWidth() (one per pixel column, up to 64), add controls (speed, trail length, color with green default, density), and a 1D render fallback so it can also absorb matrix-green-waterfall-1d.

name: Dire Spider 2D
concept: Halloween: an orange jointed spider crawls across from random directions while toxic-green ridged-noise mist and spiral rays boil around it, composited additively.
technique: per-pixel capsule SDF + polar perlinRidge haze
visual_verdict: Strong: bold orange spider with red abdomen over swirling green haze rings; first and last frames are near-empty haze while the spider is off screen.
perf_smell: per pixel: 3-octave perlinRidge + hypot + atan2 + 8 segment distances + 2 hypot (2.0 ms/1024 px)
cleanroom_quality: Clear improvement over the spec (real jointed legs, additive bloom); the idea is delivered.
action_notes: Survivor for both spider patterns (Glow 0 = plain crawling spider). Move to renderBulk: haze into a small polar canvas (e.g. 48x16) once per frame painted with fillCanvas, then the spider as 16 drawLine capsules + fillCircle body in add mode (transforms apply to coordinate-space ops); shorten the off-screen gap and give Glow percent units.

name: distance function kaleidoscope 2
concept: Six-fold kaleidoscope of taxicab/chessboard distance bands XORed on fixed-point bits into Sierpinski filigree, graded by ridged noise under a breathing envelope.
technique: per-pixel XOR distance + perlinRidge + per-pixel temporal memory
visual_verdict: Black for most of the 8 s (61/160 frames lit); when lit it is a dim muddy green/red radial confetti with no readable filigree.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) temporal memories (32,768 elements at 16384 px, over the 10,240 array budget) + perlinRidge + hypot + atan2 + cos/sin per pixel
cleanroom_quality: Mechanically follows the spec, but the result is a dark, noisy wash; the 'breathing' envelope added to rescue it makes it black most of the time.
action_notes: The XOR-filigree idea already lives in xorcery-2d-3d and the kaleidoscope fold in kaleidoscope-2d/zoom-kaleidoscope; if anything is kept, add a 6-fold Fold control to xorcery-2d-3d rather than carrying this per-pixel-memory pattern that cannot allocate on a 128x128 chain.

name: DNA Helix 2D
concept: Rotating double helix: two phase-offset sine strands with depth dimming and gold rungs between them.
visual_verdict: Clean cyan and magenta strands with pale gold rungs, depth cue reads well; crisp and legible, though static in composition (just scrolls).
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Add controls (turns across panel, rotation seconds, strand colors, vertical orientation) and a 1D fallback; consider a slow twist/zoom so the composition changes over time.

name: Doom Fire 2D
concept: PSX Doom fire: heat rises from a hidden source row with random cooling and wind sway on a 16x16 double-buffered sim; dragon-breath mode.
visual_verdict: Low, dim orange embers in the bottom third only; blocky 16x16 cells, top two thirds black.
perf_smell: hard-coded 16x16 with floor(y*15.99) row arithmetic; per-cell random() in an interpreted loop
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Near-identical to doom-fire.js (same sim, same dragon mode, same 16x16); keep its smoother wind sway and flame-height-as-reach logic when rewriting doom-fire, then delete this file.

name: Doom Fire
concept: PSX Doom fire: neighbor propagation with height-dependent random cooling, gusty wind, dragon-breath eruptions.
visual_verdict: Ember bed in the lower third with sparse red flecks above; dim, short, blocky at 16x16 - not the roaring Doom fire the name promises.
perf_smell: hard-coded 16x16 with floor(y*15.99) row arithmetic; interpreted per-cell sim
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the spec's mechanics, but the default flame height and cubed brightness leave most of the panel black; the spec's own advice to derive size from the map was not taken.
action_notes: Survivor for the two Doom fires: size the sim from gridWidth/gridHeight (cap ~32x32, upsampled), output via paintCanvas with a black-red-orange-yellow-white palette in renderBulk, taller default flames, real-unit controls (flame height %, steps/s, wind %), Dragon as a toggle, plus a 1D strip mode (one column).

name: Drip
concept: A faucet drop swells at pixel 0, tears off, falls under gravity and splashes at the far end.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows a dim blue drop accelerating down the strip with sparse single-pixel dots and a tiny splash; readable but faint and lonely.
perf_smell: array(pixelCount) + feedback where fade() on the renderBulk frame suffices
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: renderBulk with fade() trails and fillRange for a motion-blurred drop; add several staggered drips, a splash that throws droplets back up the strip, and controls (drip interval s, color, gravity); on a 2D map drop multiple columns.

name: Easing Library v1.0
concept: Demo that steps through the thirty easing builtins, graphing each curve (2D) or warping a rainbow (1D), with a marker tracing velocity.
visual_verdict: A rainbow curve plotted over a grey diagonal with a single white dot; a math graph, not a light show.
perf_smell: mapPixels scan to discover grid size (gridWidth() exists)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the demo; the library half is obsolete since easings are builtins.
action_notes: Documentation, not content: move the curve-grapher to docs/lang.md (or a web-UI easing preview) and drop it from the shipped library.

name: Edgeburst
concept: A rainbow front bursts from the strip center, sweeps to both ends and collapses back, from one clamped tent+bounce expression.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows a thin rainbow chevron sweeping out and back with long black gaps (about half the frames are black).
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Cheap classic worth keeping on strips: add Period seconds and Band width controls, shorten the dead time so a new burst launches as the last collapses, and give it a 2D radial mode (burst from center as a ring).

name: Ember Diffusion
concept: Random sparks ignite pixels and heat diffuses and cools along the strip via the double-buffered pixelState buffer.
visual_verdict: Dim brown-orange ember flecks that smear and cool; pleasant but very dark and low-contrast on the strip.
perf_smell: random() per pixel per frame for spark gating
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Sliders have no //# directives and exported raw vars: give them real units (sparks per second, cooling half-life s), brighten via a blackbody palette with setGamma, and spawn sparks in beforeRender (a few setPixelState calls) instead of random() per pixel.

name: Emoji Animation #2
concept: Cartoon face: two googly eyes that blink and glance over pixel-art brows/nose/mouth that flip among three expressions.
visual_verdict: Legible cute face with green irises, red nose, colored mouths; the expression flips every 0.9 s which reads as glitchy rather than emotive.
perf_smell: hypot + sqrt per pixel plus a branchy bgColor bitmap function per pixel
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: the three expressions are static pixel art and belong as sprites (or one multi-frame sprite) under a scene, with the eyes as a pattern layer or an extension of the eye-blink sprite
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec (procedural art instead of literal byte arrays); the spec's sub-second mood flipping is the weak part.
action_notes: Make a 'Face' scene: brows/mouth expressions as sprites cycling every few seconds, eyes from a blinky-eyes-2d layer (merge the googly-eye glance/blink logic there); hue slider gets degree units.

name: Example - Button w/ debounce
concept: Tutorial: software-debounced GPIO button advances a mode; the whole strip is one solid hue per mode.
visual_verdict: A single solid color that never changes without input.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful tutorial; nothing to look at by design.
action_notes: Move the debounce idiom into docs/lang.md (GPIO section) as a snippet; it is not library content.

name: Example: color hues
concept: Tutorial slideshow of 13 static position-to-hue lambdas (rainbows, solids, slivers, stripes) switching every 0.8 s.
visual_verdict: Waterfall is a strobe of flat red/green/blue bars, harsh warm slivers and magenta/green blocks; garish and jumpy.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; the idea is a lesson, not a look.
action_notes: Teaching scaffolding; fold the array-of-lambdas idiom into docs/lang.md if not already covered.

name: Example: modes and waveforms
concept: Tutorial: static white-on-black plots of 13 composed waveforms, snapping to the next every 0.65 s.
visual_verdict: Grey/white bars and ramps changing every half second; a test card.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; the idea is a lesson.
action_notes: Teaching scaffolding; the waveform catalog belongs in docs (or a web-UI waveform explorer), not the shipped library.

name: Example: Smooth Speed Slider
concept: Tutorial: scrolling rainbow whose phase is accumulated manually so the speed slider never makes it jump.
visual_verdict: Plain scrolling full rainbow, identical in look to the library's other rainbow scrollers.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; the lesson (accumulate phase instead of time()) is a doc tip.
action_notes: Delete; make sure the surviving rainbow pattern uses accumulated phase so its speed control is glitch-free, and mention the idiom in docs/lang.md.

name: Example: time and animation
concept: Tutorial reel of 14 monochrome (position, time) lambdas showing drift, bounce, chase and interference motions, switching every 0.62 s.
visual_verdict: Waterfall of grey sawtooth drifts, chevrons and moire switching every half second; a test reel, colorless.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; the idea is a lesson.
action_notes: Teaching scaffolding; move to docs.

name: Eye of Sauron
concept: Wide almond of churning ridged-noise flame with a dark vertical slit pupil and outward-streaming filaments through a black-red-gold-white palette.
visual_verdict: Instantly reads as the Eye: gold and white filaments around a crisp black slit inside a dark almond, flickering frame to frame.
perf_smell: two perlinRidge calls (3+2 octaves) + 2 hypot + atan2 per pixel
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec and improves it (burn flicker, white-hot corona at the slit).
action_notes: Survivor of the pair: add a Gaze control (0 = fixed stare, up to darting saccades) absorbing eye-of-sauron-with-movement; perf by sampling the ridged field on a small polar canvas (angle x radius) once per frame then paintCanvas/per-pixel lookup, keeping the pupil as cheap analytic math.

name: Eye of Sauron with movement
concept: Same flaming slit eye, but the pupil and tendril origin dart to random gaze points with eased saccades.
technique: per-pixel polar perlinRidge x2 + palette + gaze state
visual_verdict: Same fire, but the pupil smears into a blobby dark cone and the oval looks squarer; reads less clearly as an eye than the static version.
perf_smell: two perlinRidge calls + 2 hypot + atan2 per pixel
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the saccade idea; the cone-shaped pupil is muddier than the sibling's slit and its sliders are bare 0..1.
action_notes: Move the dwell-scaled saccade logic into eye-of-sauron behind a Gaze amount control using that file's crisp slit pupil, then delete this file.

name: _Fairies
concept: Dense field of stationary picked-hue twinkles that fade over seconds and respawn elsewhere, with a few short-lived white glints on top.
visual_verdict: Even magenta-pink speckle with occasional white pixels across every frame; pretty fairy-dust shimmer, uniform with no larger structure.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) + an interpreted loop over pixelCount/2 sparks every frame (8k iterations at 16384 px)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful and already bulk-rendered; the idea is delivered.
action_notes: Survivor for the single-hue twinkle family: drop both buffers and the per-spark loop - fade(k) on the persistent frame plus a constant birth rate of setPixel(random) per frame gives the same exponential twinkles at O(births); add Density and a hue-spread/palette mode so halloween-color-twinkles and color-twinkles can merge in.

name: Falling Sand 2D
concept: Classic falling-sand CA: grains pour from a spout, slide down the pile, speckled shades; fades and restarts when full.
visual_verdict: Clear, satisfying: a sand stream builds a speckled golden pile over 8 s; blocky at 16x16 upscaled to 32x32.
perf_smell: hard-coded 16x16 with floor(y*15.99)*gw row arithmetic
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Size the sim from gridWidth/gridHeight (cap ~64 wide) and render in renderBulk with setPixel(gridIndex) or fillCanvas; add controls (pour rate, spouts 1-3 that wander, color/rainbow sand), so it fills a 64x64 panel at native resolution.

name: Fast Palette Blending
concept: Palette-manager demo: a gradient wash slides back and forth while three preset palettes cross-fade every few seconds.
visual_verdict: Smooth blue-magenta-white chevron wash then fading into a dark green/orange landscape palette; nice gradients but just a demo of palette swapping.
perf_smell: none (user-space palette lookup only during transitions)
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: palette cycling over a gradient is what a scene ramp/setOutputPalette layer does
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; its point (a user-space dual-palette blender) is engine plumbing.
action_notes: Delete as teaching content; if a palette-cycling gradient is wanted, give the surviving gradient pattern a palette selector and crossfade between setPalette tables there.

name: fast pulse 3d
concept: Thin white-cored laser planes with rainbow fringes sweep sinusoidally through the volume while their orientation tumbles; 2D slice and 1D bands.
visual_verdict: Crisp diagonal laser lines with white cores and colored glow, angle and hue changing frame to frame; slick, though one frame is a near-black wash when the plane faces edge-on.
perf_smell: pow() per pixel (integer sharpness could be repeated multiply)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec with useful real-unit controls.
action_notes: Survivor of the fast-pulse pair (its render() already is fast pulse with a Pulses control); minor: avoid the edge-on dark frame by keeping the direction vector normalized, and replace pow with a precomputed exponent loop.

name: fast pulse
concept: One narrow white-cored rainbow pulse sweeps back and forth along a strip, racing through the middle.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows a clean white-cored pulse wrapping and reversing with colored glow; nice but identical to fast-pulse-3d's 1D path.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful.
action_notes: fast-pulse-3d's render() is this pattern plus controls; delete this file and rename the survivor 'Fast Pulse'.

name: fireblobs
concept: Two additive layers of soft half-sine blobs (orange-gold and ember red) breathe in and out at random spots for a calm fire shimmer.
technique: blob pool painted into RGB buffers + renderBulk fillRGB
visual_verdict: On the grid (index-wrapped) it shows flat orange and dark red horizontal bands appearing and fading; on a strip it would be slow orange smudges - more lava lamp than fire.
perf_smell: 4x array(pixelCount) (65k elements at 16384 px, over budget) + interpreted per-pixel window loops and squaring pass
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with the original's pool bugs fixed; the look is mild.
action_notes: Fold into heatshivers as one strip Embers pattern: both are blob pools painted into pixelCount buffers. Survivor renders in renderBulk with no buffers: fade() for afterglow, then per live blob set the brush from a fire palette at its envelope and splat(pos, 0.5, halfwidth, 1) additively (works on bare strips via the 1D coordinate fallback); fireblobs becomes the no-drift, no-shiver setting.

name: fire - blue
concept: Fire2012 heat-cell flame recolored cold: white base through cyan and deep blue to black.
visual_verdict: On a 60 px strip the cyan floods nearly the entire length with only the far end dark; reads as a blue bar with streaks, not a flame.
perf_smell: three 200-entry palette arrays where paint()/a palette would do; interpreted 3-pass sim per tick
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the spec, including its fixed cooling constant that does not scale with strip length, which is why it floods.
action_notes: Same Fire2012 sim as fire-red; becomes a Color option (red / blue / green / picked hue palette) on the survivor.

name: Fireflies
concept: Eight wandering particles on a strip flash with eased triangles into a decaying buffer, warm yellow-green.
visual_verdict: Sparse short yellow dashes scattered through the waterfall; gentle but thin and dim, about a fifth of frames empty.
perf_smell: array(pixelCount) + feedback where renderBulk fade() + setPixel would do
cleanroom_quality: File is a curated rewrite; a docs/pattern-specs/fireflies.md port spec also exists (velocity-driven brightness, decaying speed) whose idea is not used.
action_notes: Survivor of the fireflies family: renderBulk with fade() and setPixel (strip) or splat with setGlow (2D, flies wander in x/y), Color mode absorbing xmasflies/colourful-fireflies, a slow-drift preset absorbing slowflies, count scaled to pixelCount.

name: fire - red
concept: Fire2012 1D heat flame: random cooling, upward convection, sparks at the base, black-red-orange-yellow-white ramp.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows a convincing flickering flame from the base reaching about 3/4 of the strip with yellow-white roots and red tips.
perf_smell: none at strip sizes (interpreted per-cell loops)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful and good; direction mode is a source const instead of a control.
action_notes: Survivor of the Fire2012 strips (rename 'Fire 2012'): expose Direction (head/tail/ends/middle) as a mode slider, Color (red/blue/green/picked hue via setPalette+paint), Flame height % (cooling scaled by pixelCount), Sparking; absorb fire-blue.

name: firework dust
concept: Nearly black strip with random single-frame sparks of any hue popping per frame (optional fade).
visual_verdict: Sparse one-pixel colored dashes scattered on black; strip lit in only 34/160 frames - mostly nothing.
perf_smell: 2x array(pixelCount) + two random() per pixel per frame + an interpreted clear/decay loop
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to a spec that itself says the pattern is trivial.
action_notes: Random-hue confetti is one mode of a glitter/twinkle survivor; implement there as renderBulk fade() + N random setPixel per frame (N from a sparks-per-second control), then delete this file.

name: firework nova
concept: A thin rainbow spherical shell erupts from the volume center about once a second with white sparks trailing behind it.
visual_verdict: Bright rainbow ring with white glitter expanding from center on 2D; but half the frames are black between bursts and the ring is a perfect circle every time.
perf_smell: hypot3 + random() per pixel
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; adds sensible 1D/2D fallbacks and real-unit controls.
action_notes: Keep as the 3D-volume burst (it is natively 3D); randomize the burst center and tint per burst, overlap bursts so the dark gap closes, and drop the per-pixel random() in favor of a hashed spark field keyed to burst id.

name: firework rocket sparks
concept: A razor-thin warm 'rocket' glides along the strip, wrapping, with single-frame white sparks sputtering a fixed distance behind.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows a short red-to-yellow streak crawling diagonally with sparse white flecks beside it; tidy but nothing like a firework.
perf_smell: random() per pixel per frame
cleanroom_quality: Faithful with sensible fraction-of-strip fixes; the idea is thin.
action_notes: fireworks-finale already simulates real rockets with comet trails and bursts; delete this and let the survivor's rocket stage carry the sparkly-trail look.

name: Fireworks Finale
concept: Physically simulated strip fireworks: shells launch with comet trails, decelerate, burst at apogee into outward sparks that drag, droop and twinkle out; multi-break shells and a finale trigger.
technique: particles + RGB accumulation buffers + renderBulk fillRGB
visual_verdict: Only a grid sheet exists (index-wrapped rows): mostly black with a few gold/grey/violet streaks; about half the frames are dark sky, which is by design but sparse in an 8 s window.
perf_smell: 3x array(pixelCount) RGB accumulation buffers (49k elements at 16384 px)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Strip fireworks survivor: replace the three RGB buffers with the persistent renderBulk frame (fade() for trails, splat(x, 0.5, r, 1) additive deposits work on mapless strips via the 1D coordinate fallback); default launch rate a bit higher so an idle viewer is not staring at black.

name: Flash Posterize + Music Sequencer framework
concept: A beat-locked sub-pattern sequencer framework with sound detectors, shipping one demo: a drifting rainbow gradient that flips to posterized stained-glass on every kick.
visual_verdict: Index-wrapped rainbow bands alternating with blocky posterized stripes peppered with stray black separator pixels; looks broken on a grid and generic on a strip.
perf_smell: 3x array(pixelCount+1) scratch + a per-pixel segment fill loop inside render; 700+ lines of framework for one effect
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: beat-synced sequencing of sub-patterns is a scene/playlist engine feature, not library content
cleanroom_quality: Faithfully reimplements a framework whose one bundled effect is weak.
action_notes: Delete; propose the useful part (beat/tempo detection driving playlist or scene transitions) as an engine feature, and if a kick-reactive posterize effect is wanted, build it as a small sound pattern on renderBulk.

name: Flow Field 2D
concept: Twenty particles follow a morphing simplex heading field, leaving heading-colored trails on a 16x16 canvas.
visual_verdict: Sparse scattered colored blocks and short segments on black; reads as random confetti, the flow is not legible at 16x16.
perf_smell: none (bulk fillCanvas), but hard-coded 16x16 with floor(py*15.99) addressing
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Same particle-advection idea as curl-flow-2d with the weaker field (plain noise heading collects particles); fold in as a Field mode (curl / heading) and its heading-as-hue coloring as a Color mode on the survivor.

name: fractal flower
concept: A ring of recursive binary-tree petals of glowing dots whose two branch angles oscillate, morphing between rings, rosettes and pinwheels with depth-graded rainbow hues and auto-exposure.
technique: recursive particle deposit into 16x16 canvas + fillCanvas
visual_verdict: Rotating rings and spiral pinwheels in cycling single hues; attractive motion but visibly blocky (16x16 canvas) and mostly reads as a glowing donut.
perf_smell: hard-coded 16x16 canvas with floor(y*15.99) addressing; cos/sin per tree node (~770 nodes/frame) is acceptable
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec well (circular hue averaging, auto-exposure, delta-correct fade); the spec's own advice to size the buffer from the display was not taken.
action_notes: Size the canvas from gridWidth (cap 32-48) so petals resolve into dotted branches on 64x64; convert the nine bare 0..1 sliders to real units (Depth levels step 1, Petals step 1, Ring radius %, Trail half-life s, Speed x); widen default angle ranges a bit so it shows ferns/stars, not just a donut.

name: Frame Rate Scan (fast)
concept: Instrument: one full-width row per composed frame, alternating red/green, stepping down the panel, for filming dropped frames.
visual_verdict: A single red or green line at a different row each frame on black; a measurement fixture.
perf_smell: none (two native fills per frame by design)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Not library content: move the three frame-rate instruments to tools/ (or a non-shipped diagnostics folder the docs/boards.md procedure points at) and update the references in docs and .claude/rules/library.md.

name: Frame Rate Scan
concept: Instrument: self-timing sweep plus 10 ms and 100 ms clock bars and tick marks for counting displayed frames from a phone video.
visual_verdict: Thin red, blue and white vertical ticks over dotted rulers on black; a test card.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Move to tools/ (diagnostics) alongside the other two frame-rate instruments; keep it reachable for the docs/boards.md measuring procedure but out of the shipped pattern library.

name: Frame Rate Test
concept: Instrument: stroboscopic red/green field flip per composed frame plus bars, so dropped frames show as visible beat colors.
visual_verdict: A solid red field with small orange/grey/cyan status bars at the bottom in every sampled frame; a test card.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Move to tools/ diagnostics; .claude/rules/library.md cites its band() as the row-fill idiom, so repoint that reference (e.g. to docs/lang.md) when it moves.

name: Frogger 2D
concept: Self-playing Frogger: a frog crosses road and river lanes with a Smartness dial driving a BFS planner, filling lily pads, with death washes and celebrations.
visual_verdict: Readable board (brown logs, teal turtles, rainbow cars, green banks) at 16x16 cells; very dim overall and the frog is a single pixel that is hard to spot, one frame is the blue drowning wash.
perf_smell: none significant (per-pixel paintCell with lane lookups); fixed 16x16 board
cleanroom_quality: Deliberate redesign waived fidelity (spec was just sliding bars); the result is a far better idea than the original.
action_notes: Raise background/object brightness so it reads at normal brightness settings, make the frog 2x2 or pulsing on 32+ panels, and render via renderBulk fillCanvas of the 16x16 board (256 cells, not per-LED paintCell) so a 64x64 panel costs nothing.

name: Geometry Morphing Demo 2D
concept: A spinning centered figure melts through circle, cross, hexagram, square, triangle, hexagon by lerping signed distances, with rainbow contour bands.
visual_verdict: Bold filled shapes with concentric red-to-magenta/yellow-green contour bands morphing smoothly; vivid and legible, a little garish with the default filled fill.
perf_smell: two SDF evaluations with sqrt per pixel during morphs
cleanroom_quality: Faithful and with real-unit controls; the idea is delivered.
action_notes: Rename (drop 'Demo'); add hold/morph seconds and spin seconds controls, an OKLCH palette option for the contour bands, and a multi-figure mode (a 2x2 or ring of figures) for 64x64 panels.

name: glitch bands
concept: Rainbow gradient segments that shear and hard-wrap as a slope sweeps through zero, with white flashes where two traveling waves collide and hard bright/dim segmentation.
visual_verdict: Dense saturated rainbow lattice with dark diamond cells and white seams; busy and garish, never dark.
perf_smell: two pow() per pixel
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the spec's interference math; the result is visually loud with no rest.
action_notes: Give it a real 2D form (per-row shear offsets and occasional horizontal tear lines, the scanline glitch look) plus controls (glitch intensity, speed); replace pow with multiplies and let the dim segment go darker so there is contrast.

name: Glittering Jewels
concept: Soft gems bloom at random spots on a strip with breathing halos, hot cores and narrow staggered glints that whiten the core.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows violet ovals blooming and fading with white glints at their cores; elegant on a strip, single-hue by default.
perf_smell: per-pixel loop over up to 20 jewels with pow(...,10) per hit (1.27 ms/1024 px)
cleanroom_quality: File says it is a curated example from a prose description; no spec in docs/pattern-specs, so n/a.
action_notes: renderBulk: clear() then per jewel a halo splat and a core splat (mode 2 max) on the 1D coordinate fallback, glints as a brief white splat; convert Speed/Width/Sparkle bare 0..1 dials to real units (blooms per second, width % of strip, glint %), and give 2D maps round gems rather than index-wrapped smears.

name: Glitter
concept: Stateless hash-driven sparkle: each pixel re-rolls once per staggered slot and pops a near-white glint over a dim complementary backdrop.
visual_verdict: Very dark: a near-black tinted backdrop with sparse faint pale dots; reads as almost off.
perf_smell: none (hash per pixel, no buffers)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Survivor for the random-sparkle family (absorbs firework-dust as a Random-hue color mode): brighter glints, glint lifetime and sparks-per-second in real units, backdrop level control defaulting near black, color modes (white, picked hue, random rainbow).

name: GlowFlow (3D coord transform API port)
concept: A container of glowing rainbow liquid whose surface stays level with real gravity via a smoothed accelerometer transform; sound makes pixels fizz with a PI-controlled gain.
visual_verdict: On the 2D shim the rainbow strata sit in the TOP half and the bottom is dark red fizz noise, so the 'liquid' is upside down on a panel; static apart from the sparkle.
perf_smell: array(pixelCount) spark buffer with an interpreted per-pixel re-seed loop every frame plus random() per pixel
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec (switches promoted to toggles); the 2D shim maps y the wrong way round so flat fixtures show the liquid inverted.
action_notes: Rename 'GlowFlow'; fix the 2D shim so liquid fills the bottom; replace the per-pixel spark buffer with renderBulk fade() + N random sparks per frame scaled by energy; consider absorbing accelerometer-level-example as the no-sound default; give TiltSmoothing seconds units.

name: Golden Tix
concept: 1D tixy.land live-coding sandbox: one editable formula of (t, i, p) maps to signed brightness in two picked hues; default is accelerating sin(i*t) moire.
visual_verdict: Red/cyan stripes that compress into an ever-finer aliasing moire as time grows; striking for a minute, then just noise until reset.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; by the spec's own words the value is the scaffolding, not the visual.
action_notes: tixy.js is the same tixy.land contract on 2D; give tixy a 1D render path (t, i, p) and an accelerating-moire preset, then delete this sandbox. The 'slide right to reset' slider hack should not survive.

name: Gradient blue  purple pink
concept: Blue-purple-pink gradient band flowing along the strip with a slower saturation ripple beating against it.
visual_verdict: Smooth diagonal blue/violet/pink bands at full brightness; pleasant, soft, generic.
perf_smell: none
scene_or_sprite_candidate: yes: a flowing two-or-three-stop gradient is a scene color-wash/ramp layer
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with sensible real-unit controls for flow time, base hue and span.
action_notes: Fold into a single 'Gradient Flow' survivor (breathing-gradient's OKLab mixColors core) with base hue/span/flow-seconds/repeats controls and presets (blue-purple-pink as the default preset); the generic double-space name should go.

name: green ripple reflections
concept: Moonlight on water: three interfering waves on incommensurate clocks, green crests washing to white glints, brightness capped at half.
visual_verdict: Dim green diagonal lattice with faint grey glints on black; moody but murky, the glints barely read.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the spec including its half-brightness cap, which makes it murky.
action_notes: Ocean (Pacifica-style layered waves with whitecaps) is the stronger water pattern; add a 'Moonlit' palette preset there (green/teal with white glints) and delete this.

name: Halloween color twinkles
concept: Deterministic two-palette confetti: purples and pumpkin oranges twinkling on black from nested index sinusoids with a 4th-power gate.
visual_verdict: Dense static-like orange/purple speckle filling the waterfall; busy and noisy, more TV snow than twinkle.
perf_smell: none (three sines per pixel)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; the nested-sine 'randomness' produces too much density and visible index-order structure.
action_notes: Make Halloween a palette preset (orange + violet) of the twinkle survivor (fairies with a palette/hue-set mode) so it twinkles with real birth/fade instead of sine snow; delete this file.

name: Halloween Wavy Bands
concept: Ten vertical orange/violet bands whose edges wobble with perlin and ripple sideways with a traveling sine, dark seams between.
visual_verdict: Thin wavy vertical stripes in orange, red and purple across the panel; reads as striped fabric, mildly hypnotic, narrow bands look busy at 32 px.
perf_smell: perlin + sin + pow per pixel
cleanroom_quality: Faithful with useful real-unit controls.
action_notes: Identical engine to wavy-bands.js with a fixed Halloween hue table; add a Palette mode (rainbow / Halloween / Christmas) to wavy-bands and delete this file.

name: heart
concept: Antialiased construction-geometry heart (diamond + two lobes) beating about once a second, filled with a vertical rainbow that sweeps a wheel per beat.
visual_verdict: Clean, bold, well-antialiased rainbow heart pulsing in size; instantly readable and cute.
perf_smell: hypot per pixel (fine)
scene_or_sprite_candidate: no: overlaps library/scenes/heartbeat.scene and library/sprites/heart.sprite, but the analytic SDF scales and antialiases at any panel size; it should become the heart layer the Heartbeat scene uses
cleanroom_quality: Delivers and improves the spec (beat-locked hue, real-unit controls).
action_notes: Add a Fill mode (rainbow / solid picked color / OKLCH red-pink), a lub-dub double-beat easing option, and use it as a pattern layer in heartbeat.scene; rename 'Heart'.

name: heatshivers
concept: Amber pulses bloom, drift in two opposing families with a per-frame shiver, and leave a slowly decaying red heat afterglow.
technique: pulse pool + 5 pixelCount buffers + renderBulk fillRGB
visual_verdict: On the index-wrapped grid: red/amber horizontal streaks with dark-red afterglow bands; on a strip, sliding ember smudges - warm and organic but low-key.
perf_smell: 5x array(pixelCount) (82k elements at 16384 px) plus interpreted per-pixel decay/composite loop every frame
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with the generated original's slot bugs fixed.
action_notes: Survivor 'Embers' (absorbs fireblobs): renderBulk only - fade(halfLife) for the afterglow on the persistent frame, then per pulse an additive splat at its jittered position with an amber brush; add controls (pulses/s, drift %, shiver %, afterglow s) and a 2D mode where embers drift upward.

name: Holiday_Diagonal_Stripes
concept: Solid red/white/green diagonal stripes scrolling across a 2D panel, banded from a sine split into thirds.
visual_verdict: Dense, aliased, jaggy red/white/green diagonals at maximum saturation; garish wrapping-paper look with staircase edges.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, including the unequal mirrored bands the spec asks to preserve; the result is harsh at LED resolution.
action_notes: Give the candy-cane survivor a 2D render (antialiased diagonal stripes with an angle control in degrees and a palette: red/white, red/white/green) and drop this file.

name: Ice Floes 2D
concept: Animated Voronoi river ice: floes glow icy white at centers, fade to deep blue, dark seams where two cells meet, all drifting upstream.
visual_verdict: Pale blue-white cells with blue crack seams drifting; pretty icy palette but chunky at 16x16 and seams are blocky staircases.
perf_smell: hard-coded 16x16 canvas; hypot per cell per point (cheap)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful (bounce at both banks), with real-unit controls.
action_notes: Make 'Ice' a preset/draw mode of voronoi-2d (F2-F1 crack seams, blue-white ramp, one-way river drift with toroidal wrap) computed on a canvas sized from the grid (32x32) so seams are thin; delete this file.

name: Infinity Flower 2D
concept: Endless random 'species' of phyllotaxis flowers: a contrasting center disc and golden-angle petals that spin and regenerate every couple of seconds.
visual_verdict: Small, sparse, speckled flowers occupying the middle third of the panel; petals render as broken outline dashes, not leaves; mostly black.
perf_smell: hypot + atan2 + per-pixel loop over up to 12 petals with mod
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec's mechanics (golden angle, golden-conjugate center), but the spec's outline-style petals with dim centerlines look broken at LED resolution.
action_notes: renderBulk: petals as tapered drawLine capsules (or 2-3 splats each) radiating at golden-angle steps, fillCircle/splat center, filling ~90% of the panel; replace the spin-and-pop transition with a bloom (petals grow out, wilt, next species), add Hold seconds and Size controls.

name: Interference 2D
concept: Three orbiting point sources summed as wave(dist*f) give drifting interference fringes, rendered through OKLCH with a slow hue walk.
visual_verdict: Smooth moire of rings in a single drifting hue (amber to green to blue to violet over 8 s); calm and pretty, a bit dim.
perf_smell: three dist() per pixel (fine)
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Bug: sliderFrequency declares min=2 max=12 default=6 but still rescales (freq = 2 + v*10), so the UI default seeds freq = 62 - clamp v instead. Also raise OKLCH lightness ceiling, add source count and orbit-speed controls.

name: Kaleidoscope 2D
concept: Stained-glass kaleidoscope: domain-warped simplex plus three orbiting blobs folded into N mirrored wedges, quantized into color cells with dark leading, spinning.
visual_verdict: Vivid, symmetric, constantly recombining star/flower mandalas with dark leading lines; a real showpiece, slightly saturated-garish palette.
perf_smell: hypot + atan2 + cos + sin + 2 simplex3 per pixel (0.78 ms/1024 px)
cleanroom_quality: Deliberate redesign (fidelity waived); far better than a literal perlin kaleidoscope.
action_notes: Kaleidoscope survivor. Perf: evaluate the source field once per frame on a small wedge canvas (radius x angle, e.g. 32x16 via fillNoise3D plus blob terms) and fold per pixel by lookup, or render one wedge and mirror; add an OKLCH palette option to tame the garish hues.

name: KITT
concept: Classic Knight Rider scanner: red head bouncing end to end with a decaying red-orange comet tail.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows a red head zig-zagging with a long smooth fading tail; correct and warm, but it is the canonical scanner and nothing more.
perf_smell: array(pixelCount) + interpreted per-pixel decay loop (fade() on a renderBulk frame does this natively)
cleanroom_quality: File is a terse curated rewrite rather than the spec (time()-driven head, multiplicative decay, no controls); fine look, no controls.
action_notes: Scanner survivor absorbing cylon and kitt-w-color-picker (and scanner.js): renderBulk with fade(k) per frame, fillRange stamping the span crossed since last frame, controls for color picker (default red), Sweep seconds, Tail seconds, Eyes 1-2, Easing toggle; 2D mode sweeps a vertical bar.

name: KITT (w/ color picker)
concept: Fast colored scanner with a short gap-filled comet tail; hue from a picker.
technique: per-pixel decay buffer with gap fill
visual_verdict: Very fast thin red streaks zig-zagging; tail is so short it reads as a moving dash.
perf_smell: array(pixelCount) + interpreted decay loop
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, with a sensible ramped gap fill.
action_notes: Its gap-fill-with-ramp and color picker go into the kitt survivor; delete this file.

name: Lightbulb - Crank Hue to Complete
concept: Museum-exhibit state machine: a hand-crank GPIO steps two filament coils through the rainbow to a success strobe; rests breathing gold.
visual_verdict: Two flat halves (gold and beige) breathing slowly; nothing happens without the crank input.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to a one-off installation's logic.
action_notes: Single-installation exhibit code with no value as library content; at most a docs example of a GPIO-driven state machine.

name: Lightning clouds
concept: Dim drifting blue night clouds (2-octave perlin turbulence) that light up from behind around random lightning flashes, cores whitening.
visual_verdict: Almost entirely black; faint grey-blue cloud texture with a few small white smudges where flashes hit; 56/160 frames essentially dark.
perf_smell: two perlin() + dist per pixel every frame for a mostly dark field
cleanroom_quality: Faithful (strike rate normalized per second); the spec's ambient floor of a few percent leaves the clouds invisible at LED brightness.
action_notes: Become the 2D path of a single Thunderstorm survivor: clouds via fillNoise3D on a 32x32 canvas + paintCanvas each frame, ambient floor raised to ~15%, flashes that light whole cloud banks plus an actual forked bolt drawn with drawLine segments, timed by lightning-strike's leader/return-stroke/restrike state machine.

name: Lightning Strike
concept: Physically informed strip thunderstorm: stepped leader flicker, single-frame return stroke, dimmer restrikes, jagged channel with branch stubs, afterglow, sheet lightning, clustered bursts.
visual_verdict: Strip waterfall: a single bright white-blue jagged bolt with restrikes and glow in 8 s, otherwise black (13/160 lit frames); convincing when it fires, but an idle viewer mostly sees darkness.
perf_smell: 3x array(pixelCount) and interpreted per-pixel exp-decay loop every frame even when dark
cleanroom_quality: n/a
action_notes: Thunderstorm survivor: keep the excellent state machine, render via renderBulk with fade() decay (drop hot/glow buffers, keep only the channel profile), add a 2D path absorbing lightning-clouds (backlit cloud canvas + drawLine forked bolt), default ~20 strikes/min and a dim rain/cloud floor so the strip is never fully black.

name: Light Organ - 2.0
concept: Club light organ: four tiled colored bars pulse with bass/low/mid/high through equal-loudness weighting and per-band adaptive gain; beats reshuffle widths and hues; song gaps drop to a dim idle shimmer.
visual_verdict: Waterfall shows bold tiled red/green/blue/violet blocks re-laid on beats with grey accent dots; punchy and clearly music-driven, but blocky and grey dots look like dead pixels.
perf_smell: none (band math per frame, modulo per pixel)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the AGC/beat/gap design but simplifies the harmonic-rejecting peak tracker to plain band max (acceptable); the white overlay renders grey.
action_notes: Light organ survivor (absorb light-organ-sensor-board as a 'fixed hues / rotating slots' color mode): real-unit controls (sensitivity, decay ms, bar width px), make the beat accent a true white flash, and a 2D mode with four vertical columns.

name: Light Organ -- sensor board
concept: Four-channel light organ with per-band AGC, beat-rotated slot assignments, marching white accents and a two-timescale silence gate.
visual_verdict: Bright multi-color tiled bars with white accents at first, then the gate drops it to dim scattered violet/teal dots for most of the run with the synthetic signal.
perf_smell: none
cleanroom_quality: Faithful; same concept as light-organ-2-0 with a cruder AGC and an over-eager silence gate.
action_notes: Keep its fixed band hues (bass red, low orange, high violet) as a color mode in the survivor; delete this file.

name: Line Dancer 2D
concept: A rainbow-striped ribbon twisting and coiling about the center via a radius-dependent shear, with a breathing zoom and optional kaleidoscope wedges.
visual_verdict: Vivid coiling rainbow ribbons in most frames, but two of eight frames are the deliberate 'melt' trough: a muddy dim orange/brown gradient with a dark swirl.
perf_smell: hypot + cos + sin per pixel (+ atan2 with kaleidoscope on)
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec's shear-warp look; the extended zoom trough was a choice that produces dull frames.
action_notes: Shorten or floor the zoom trough so the ribbon never melts into a brown wash; convert the three bare 0..1 dials to real units (speed x, twist, Reflections 1-7 step 1) and mirror alternate wedges for seamless kaleidoscope mode.

name: Lissajous curve tracer
concept: A dot traces a Lissajous figure with oscilloscope-style persistence, its hue wandering around a picked color so trails carry a color history.
visual_verdict: Chunky blue/cyan zig-zag strokes of a Lissajous figure; the 16x16 canvas makes it look like a low-res scope, monochrome blue by default.
perf_smell: hard-coded 16x16 with floor(y*15.99)*16 indexing; per-cell segment distance loop every frame
cleanroom_quality: Delivers the spec well (segment stamping, delta-correct fade, jump-free clocks).
action_notes: renderBulk at native resolution: fade(persistence) on the frame then one drawLine(prev, cur, width) per frame (or a few sub-steps) with the wandering hue as the brush; replaces both canvases and the per-cell loop. Convert the 7 bare 0..1 dials to real units (A/B 1-8 step 1, phase degrees, trail seconds, circuit seconds); consider merging spirograph-2d in as a mode.

name: M5Stack Hex panels
concept: Six-mode demo for a specific product (37-px hex tiles mapped in 3D): rings, rotating bar, radar wedge, tile wipe, iris, hard-coded status clusters.
visual_verdict: Default mode only: a single soft ring growing from the center and vanishing, two of eight frames black; generic.
perf_smell: atan2 + hypot per pixel regardless of mode
cleanroom_quality: Faithful, including product-specific hard-coded tile size and cluster indices.
action_notes: Hardware-specific demo reel whose modes are each weaker duplicates of dedicated library patterns (rings, radar, iris); delete.

name: Mandelbrot 2D
concept: Animated Julia set (misnamed Mandelbrot): the constant sweeps along a diagonal near the boundary so the fractal blooms and collapses, escape bands in a rotating rainbow.
visual_verdict: Flat, full-brightness hard rainbow bands with black interiors; some frames show nice fractal fringes, others are a single solid-color field or mostly black; harsh, posterized look.
perf_smell: up to 14-19 interpreted iterations per pixel per frame (0.84 ms/1024 px; ~55k iterations/frame on 64x64)
cleanroom_quality: Faithful to the spec's Julia construction and coloring; the coloring (integer bands, full value) is what makes it look cheap.
action_notes: Rename 'Julia Morph'; compute on a 32x32 (or gridWidth-capped) canvas once per frame and output via paintCanvas, smooth escape coloring through a deep palette with brightness falling toward the set, a c-path that orbits the main cardioid edge so every frame is rich, slow zoom; real-unit Iterations step 1.
